source: Existing native Blender AREA light objects; no added light

conversion.quaternion: RotX(-pi/2) left-multiplied by native world quaternion; output [x,y,z,w]
conversion.emissionDirection: Light local -Z preserved by the basis conversion
conversion.widthHeight: Native size / size_y, multiplied by positive native world X / Y scale
conversion.circularArea: pi * width * height / 4 for DISK and ELLIPSE
conversion.rectangularArea: width * height for RECTANGLE and SQUARE
conversion.threeRadiance: 683 * native energy watts / (pi * area square metres)
conversion.color: Native Blender light data RGB floats preserved as linear RGB
conversion.threeUsage: Use ShapedAreaLight; isCircular for DISK/ELLIPSE; intensity=radiance; setRGB with LinearSRGBColorSpace
